sections.title: 📚 Why Learn Sanskrit?
sections.content: Sanskrit is the mother of many languages and the key to ancient wisdom.
points: ✅ The oldest continuous literary tradition in the world
✅ 99% of ancient Indian knowledge is written in Sanskrit
✅ Improves cognitive skills and logical thinking
✅ Gateway to Yoga, Ayurveda, and Indian philosophy

sections.title: 🎯 Quick Quiz
sections.instructions: Choose the correct Sanskrit word for each English word.

questions.explanation: 'नमस्ते' (Namaste) is the most common Sanskrit greeting.
'योगः' (Yogaḥ) comes from the root 'yuj' meaning 'to unite'.
